questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in SQL?
questions.explanation: In SQL, -- marks a comment. Block comments use /* */.

questions.question: What does PARTITION BY do in a window function?
questions.correctAnswer: Groups rows into independent windows for calculation

questions.question: True or False: Each partition computes rankings/sums independently.
